g.text: STEM profiles and supplied signal distributions
10 source-selected profiles; 1270 trajectory identifiers; 438 matched signal genes; no time-comparison tests
Red: STEM model (not a representative gene); gray: supplied transformed trajectories; time points are equally spaced categories.
Boxes: per-gene median across annotated spots and two supplied matrices; outliers shown; nT/nB count trajectory/signal genes, not independent replicates.
Exact Gene Symbol matching only; unmatched identifiers and missing measurements are exported. No time-comparison significance is asserted.
